लवङ्ग: लवङ्ग (1) SYZYGIUM AROMATICUM (LINN.) MERRILL ET PERRY (Bpn, p. 219; Chopra) = EUGENIA CARYOPHYLLATA THUNB. (Watt CP, p. 526-530) [= E. CARYOPHYLLATA WILLD.] (Nadk. 1, nr. 965; Roxb., p. 401); see Hooker 2, p. 506; [= E. CARYOPHYLLATA LINN.] (Ainslie 1, p. 75-77) = E. CARYOPHYLLATA (Nadk. 1, nr. 1682) [= E. AROMATICA KUNTZE] (Bpn, p. 219; Chopra) = E. AROMATICA BAILL. = CARYO-PHYLLUS AROMATICUS LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 219; Dgv, nr. 151; Dutt; DWH 2, p. 20-23; Gul; HB; HK; Kav; Na 1, nr. 213; Nadk. 1, nr. 485; Vśs); (2) EUGENIA CARYOPHYLLUS (SPRENG.) BULLOCK ET S. G. HARRISON = E. CARYOPHYLLAEA WIGHT = MYRTUS CARYOPHYLLUS SPRENG. (Nadk. 1, nr. 1682).
लशुन: लशुन ALLIUM SATIVUM LINN.; see R. Bedi: Garlic, in P. K. Gode Comm. Vol., 1960, p. 9-18; J. Jolly: Der Knoblauch in der indischen Medizin, in: Festgruss an R. von Roth, 1893, p. 18-20.
लोध्र: लोध्र (1) SYMPLOCOS RACEMOSA ROXB.; (2) S. THEIFOLIA (Nadk. 1, nr. 2420); the Index Kewensis records: a) S. THEIFOLIA HAYATA = S. ADINANDRIFOLIA VAR. THEIFOLIA HAYATA; b) S. THEAEFOLIA D. DON; (3) S. CRATAEGOIDES BUCH.-HAM. EX D. DON (see Bpn, p. 130; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 204; KB 2, p. 1510-1511; PA 1, 3, p. 65-71; V 9, p. 42: पट्टिकालोध्र, वल्कलोध्र) = S. PANICULATA WALL. EX D. DON (Chopra); (4) S. SPICATA ROXB. (PA 1, 3, p. 65-76); (5) DESMODIUM PULCHELLUM BENTH. (PA 1, 3, p. 75-76) = HEDY-SARUM PULCHELLUM LINN. (PA 1, 3, p. 75) = DICERMA PULCHELLUM DC. (PA 1, 3, p. 75, footnote: “This plant has been equated as लोध्र by Rama Rao in his ‘Flowering plants of Travancore’ and Sir R. N. Chopra in his ‘Indigenous drugs of India’; it is, however, very doubtful whether this plant is used as the source of लोध्र any where in Travan-core-Cochin or in India”).
लता: latā (1) = latākastūrī (Śivadāsa on Cakradatta, vātavyādhi 117); (2) = priyaṅgu (HK; Bt.; Na 1, nr. 201; Nś. 187; Śivadāsa on Cakradatta, vraṇaśotha 90; Indu on A.s.U. 30, 80); (3) = dūrvā (Śivadāsa on Cakradatta, vraṇaśotha 90; Indu on A.s.U. 30, 80; Dha.nigh. 4, 143-144; Bt.; Nś. 380ab: = śvetadūrvā); (4) = jyotiṣmatī (Bpn, harītakyādivarga 171); (5) = trapusa (Dha.nigh. 1, 175); (6) = sārivā (Nś. 313; HB; Rā.nigh., pariśiṣṭa, tryarthāni 17); (7) = mañjiṣṭhā (Bt.); (8) = atimukta (Nś. 37cd-38ab); (9) = spṛkkā (Nś. 170-171); (10) = jāti (Nś. 235cd-236ab); (11) = cirbhiṭī (Nś. 363).
लाङ्गली: lāṅgalī̆, lāṅgalikā, etc. (1) Gloriosa superba Linn. (HK; Gul; HB; Nadk. 1, nr. 1129; WIRM 4, p. 139; CD, p. 247-249; KB 4, p. 2525-2528; Bt.; Dutt; Sharma; Kai.Nigh., oṣa-dhivarga 1075-1076; Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 80); (2) Hydrolea zeylanica Vahl. (KB 3, p. 1672; Nadk. 1, nr. 1267; WIRM 5, p. 147; Chopra); (3) = kapikacchū (Bpn, guḍūcyādivarga 129); (4) = jalapippalī (ibid. 294; Nś. 288); (5) = nārikela = nārikera = nālikera (Bpn, āmrādiphalavarga 38; Nś. 179cd-180ab; Amarakośa 2, 4, 169); (6) = pṛśniparṇī (Nś. 198).
